summary: Third security review found quoted or indirect make targets can still hide make ci, and extra release jobs can inherit publication authority outside the checked job.
validation: Prior CI job/permission and wrapper-option findings were resolved
blockers: Reject quoted or variable make targets rather than ignoring them.
Require the release workflow job map to contain exactly release.
next_action: Harden the parser and release job shape, add tests, then repeat review.

issues.title: Quoted or indirect make target bypasses parser
issues.details: make ci-pr followed by make "ci" or make "$target" can execute privileged ci while parser ignores quoted target; reject unsupported quoted/indirect targets.

issues.title: Extra release jobs inherit publication permissions
issues.details: Require release jobs map to contain exactly release so added jobs cannot execute with top-level write authority unchecked.
